publisher.title: Publisher

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body:
Application: Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, United States (vercel.com).
Accounts and synced data: Supabase Inc., 970 Toa Payoh North #07-04, Singapore 318992 (supabase.com). The database is located in the European Union (Ireland).

data.title: Data collected
data.body:
Without an account: everything stays in your browser, nothing is sent to a server.
With an account: your email address, your account ID (and, if you sign in with Google, the name and picture provided by Google) and the content of your profile (name, avatar, factions, quests, progress and history). The hosting providers also keep technical logs (IP address, sign-in time) for security purposes.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal basis
purposes.body: This data is only used to authenticate you and sync your profile across your devices. This processing is necessary for the service you request by creating an account (GDPR article 6.1.b). No advertising, no data selling, no analytics.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.body: Only the publisher and its technical processors can access it: Supabase (authentication and database), Vercel (hosting) and Google (only if you choose Google sign-in). As these companies may process data outside the European Union, transfers are covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or the Data Privacy Framework.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. When you request deletion, the account and its profile are erased within 30 days. Technical logs are kept for a limited time by the hosting providers.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.body: Renown Tracker uses no advertising cookies or trackers. Your browser's local storage is only used to run the app (sign-in session, language and theme preferences, local copy of your profile), so no consent is required.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data (exporting your profile as JSON already lets you retrieve it). To exercise these rights, write to {{email}}. You can also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in France, the CNIL: cnil.fr).
